news.title: Michigan gave schools $224M for infrastructure, but they need billions
news.summary_en: Michigan is one of eight states where bonds are the primary funding source for school infrastructure costs, researchers found. The state recently awarded grants, but public schools still need $22.8 billion in repairs.
news.author: Matt Mencarini

news.title: Michigan college students struggle with housing, food. Program aims to help
news.summary_en: Students at Henry Ford College and Wayne State University with basic needs will have access to a United Way official to direct them to resources on and off campus.
news.author: Kim Kozlowski

news.title: A renewed push to ban seclusion, reduce restraint in Michigan schools
news.summary_en: Michigan students were secluded or restrained nearly 18,000 times during the 2024-2025 school year. Advocates say more staff training and an emphasis on prevention would help students.
news.author: Isabel Lohman
